svg.title: Zava Forward technical architecture: 8 November source continuation
svg.desc: Retained core layout and icons; home sensors feed Basic B1 IoT Hub, Event Hubs and shared-API validated SQL telemetry/history. Read-only averages are computed on read; persisted per-home averages and quality-helper linkage are gated targets. A separate resident website has independently supplied SQL and optional public Sweden Central AI outside the core boundary. No new infrastructure adoption, live acceptance, diagnosis, consent or safety release is implied.

g.text: CTO + technical architects / 8 November 2026 continuation / original PR #68 topology / static view, not a live Azure inventory
GREEN: documented core | BLUE: source-configured | PURPLE: conditional / OFF | AMBER: deferred, not working services
Azure resource group ama / UK South exercise / development public-network exceptions
Container Apps environment / VNet + mTLS configured
API read; maintenance writes one secret
Account + project; standard and capable deployments
API managed-identity invocation; typed output validation
No Foundry Agent Service / autonomous manager deployed
Validated principal -> tenant/object/app roles -> role/case/field checks
Deterministic workflow / ranking / consent / independent approvals
Five shared assists: capture -> reserve -> infer -> validate -> store draft
SQL owns dedupe, leases, durable limits and source-verified review
Normal five-assistant authority absent / proactive OFF.
Disabled or failed assistance never blocks ordinary case controls.
Cases, row versions, audit, proposals, snapshots, leases + usage
Short transactions; model call outside database locks
14-day PITR configured; restore acceptance remains separate
Private containers; upload / download through the API
Document bytes in Blob; references + content hashes in SQL
Five-assistant capture uses permitted metadata, not whole files
Own identity; one Key Vault secret write
Digest-pinned image pull with workload identities
Operator builds; CI tests, scans and produces SBOM, not auto-deploy
API 5xx + restarts / SQL CPU / model client errors -> email
Budget: 80% actual + 100% forecast; alerts are not a hard cap
Deferred ADR 0001 topology / placeholder workloads, not the five-assistant runtime
Proposed context + proposals through API only
No SQL / Blob / Key Vault credential
Defined resources, not running business flows
Enqueues tasks; not an autonomous supervisor
Proposed validated import to limited SQL role
Quarantine via Blob; no workbook write-back
Not deployed in this Bicep or exercise
No live sending, submission or approval
Not a second system of record
Five-assistant inference never holds database locks and never approves domain changes. Responses are implicit unless double-headed.
Blue arrows are configured relationships, not proof of end-to-end telemetry or private-only access. Deferred boxes are not working code.
Email / Teams alerts do not replace owned safety response. Historical Decision 1 evaluation is not a current API runtime dependency.
8 NOVEMBER SOURCE CONTINUATION / NOT A NEW CLOUD INVENTORY OR LIVE MONITORING ACCEPTANCE
Read-only retained analysis uses trusted consent + readings.
Exercise baseline / early / late window means computed on read.
Insufficient / stale / declined -> manual review; no priority effect.
No task creation, diagnosis, consent authority or safety release.
TARGET: persisted household averages / history service
Existing shared API + Azure SQL are the proposed responsibility boundary.
Average materialization/persistence is not implemented; no new Azure service adopted.
Quality Verification post-retrofit linkage remains a separately gated target.
Current quality-evidence helper uses measures / checklists / documents, not telemetry.
Synthetic showcase session, not staff Entra enrolment
Not proof of shared-case/staff SQL integration
No assumed credentials or accepted network reachability
Optional resident OpenAI / outside core boundary
Public Sweden Central Standard model, off by default
Separate resident assistant deployment, not UK/private core
Real-data authority, privacy and provider acceptance remain gated
SOURCE-CODED / GATED TARGETS ARE DISTINCT. No ADX/Fabric/standalone analytics worker, stored averages implementation or new infrastructure adoption.
People retain consent, professional judgement, quality acceptance and release. Missing/stale/declined data never means a safe home.
